shortcut.hint: The case dial sends the PC a volume change signal. Here you decide what that signal does: with SUPER held, for example, switch workspace instead of touching the volume. Repeated presses are grouped so double and triple presses can be detected.
shortcut.note: For the signal to reach the PC, the gesture must be mapped to a volume action (e.g. triple press of the case button → Volume up). Note: if a gesture has a rule with a number of presses (2, 3...), the 'Any' rule for that same gesture is ignored; the N-press rule wins.
